mentions.why: Daily-changing seafood menu; walk-in bar is the move if you didn't book.
Wellington Street cafe with single-origin matcha lineup and a koji-cured salmon bagel.
Still pulling queues six months in; salted cream coffee plus a new matcha basque cheesecake.
